name: kaspi_shop_api-mcp
description: Kaspi.kz Shop (merchant API) (ecommerce suppliers): me, get_order. Every tool maps to a documented e

platform_mcp_kaspi_shop_api_token.title: PLATFORM_MCP_KASPI_SHOP_API_TOKEN
platform_mcp_kaspi_shop_api_token.description: Kaspi.kz merchant authorisation token from the seller cabinet (Настройки > Токен API), sent as the X-Auth-Token header.

tools.name: me
tools.description: No account endpoint; the probe reads the product-import JSON schema, which requires a valid X-Auth-Token.

tools.name: get_order
tools.description: GET /v2/orders?filter[orders][code]={id}: `id` is the order NUMBER (attribute code) of a customer order placed with your shop. status is APPROVED_BY_BANK, ACCEPTED_BY_MERCHANT, COMPLETED, CANCELLED, CANCELLING, KASPI_DELIVERY_RETURN_REQUESTED or RETURNED; totalPrice is in tenge; dates are epoch milliseconds (creation_date_ms). The order entries are at /v2/orders/{uid}/entries (not mapped).
